key_insight: Choose LLMs using application-specific capability profiles rather than universal leaderboard rankings.
engineering_relevance: A containerized testbed helps engineers evaluate models within their intended application, architecture, and cost context.
method: Package each application with its own dataset, evaluator, attributes, and dashboards behind a shared contract.
Accumulate measurements in versioned, sparse model profiles using frozen, hashed plans and context-matched comparisons.
Separate tested models from judges and agents; validate the test instrument with null-agent checks and a simulation-characterized noise rule.
evidence_signal: Of 216 migration units checked against a real Oracle database, 108 were demonstrably correct, showing why reported success requires independent verification.
watch_item: Results are application-specific, and the experimental design does not establish a general causal ranking of model versus framework effects.
paper_title: Beyond Leaderboards: A Method for Application-Specific Capability Profiling of Large Language Models
